title: Low Lying Zeros of Dedekind Zeta Functions
summary: Let $K$ be a number field of degree $n_K$, and let $h(K)$ denote the smallest absolute value of the imaginary part of a non-trivial zero of its Dedekind zeta function. In 1979, Hoffstein proved the unconditional bound $h(K)\leq 0.87+o(1)$ as $n_K\to\infty$. In a 1990 survey article, Odlyzko stated without proof that a different kernel in Weil's explicit formula could produce $h(K)\leq 0.54+o(1)$.
